notes.title: Support for Ukraine
notes.content:
Hello!

I have lived in Ukraine all my life.
Now in my country there is a full-scale war with Russia, which insidiously attacked our lands.
We are fighting, we are not giving up and we will not give up thanks to the invincibility of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the support of each other. And you too can be a part of our struggle.

Path to Heaven is a small game and in the sense of development it is very simple, but if you buy it, these funds will go to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine, which is currently defending our lands.

Thank you for attention. Peace to all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374806/a8b7606df3baf13d83445f29c79d03aa1226342e.png[/img]

notes.title: The Void Update is now available for download
notes.content:
Hello! 

The Void Update for Path to Heaven is now available to all players.

This update brings ten new levels to the game and completes a story that was started in the game's original levels.

In addition, several bugs was fixed in the game and some changes were made:
[list]
[*] the color of the main character was not displayed and because of this there was just a black texture;
[*] checkpoints are now enabled by default, as some players didn't know that they can be activated and it was difficult for them to complete levels (you always can turn them on or off in the settings);
[*] the game finds a gamepad if you connect it while passing a level, and not just in the menu. Before fixing this, the game only found the gamepad in the main menu;
[/list]
There are also new settings for the character:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374806/b93b7e1415792bebf9a40b4a775889a77e452cc0.png[/img]

Unfortunately, due to low interest in the game, the Challenge Update was canceled to focus on the development of the next game.

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Hello! [b]Path to Heaven[/b] has become available for purchase.

The game includes up to 5 hours of content and that's not all. In the future, I plan to release two updates: Void and Challenge Update. These two updates will bring about 2-5 hours of new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374806/cbbbfcac862b1fbaa455770f86adb144720472ab.jpg[/img]

[b]Void Update[/b] is ten new levels and the completion of the story that was started in Path to Heaven. It will add many different obstacles and traps to the game.

[b]Challenge Update [/b]is a different trials for a player. You will need to pass the levels over time, without deaths and more.

I plan to release both updates by the end of the summer.
Thanks to everyone who bought the game. Have a good trip to Heaven!
